description: This file contains the Laravel-style PHP class 'Subscription' that manages subscription-related operations, such as retrieving subscription details, counts, histories, and associated products within an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on subscription data.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents the subscription model, providing methods to retrieve and manage subscription data from the database, including subscription info, associated products, histories, and counts, within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record by its ID, including payment and shipping methods decoded from JSON, if present.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription records for the current customer with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Counts total number of subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details linked to specific order and product IDs.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products associated with a particular subscription.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts total products linked to a specific subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for a subscription's product.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history log entries for a subscription, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a subscription.
